descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**Peak Rhythm** is a VR rhythm-climbing game where music drives momentum. Every grab and twist powers your robotic platform upward through a neon-soaked city.

Sync your moves to a high-octane electronic soundtrack to master the flow and dominate global leaderboards. Blending physical precision with Cyberpunk aesthetics and Y2K energy, your rhythm is your engine.

[media]

### 🕹️ GAME FEATURES

- **Rhythm-Powered Climbing:** Master “Regular” grabs, “Multi-Twists” (volume knob motion), and “Double” holds on a 5x5 grid. Perfect hits boost your speed; misses slow you down.
- **Solo Mastery:** Ascend 7 original tracks across 3 difficulties to perfect your runs. Compete for the highest altitude on map-specific leaderboards.
- **The Soundtrack:** Launching with music from indie artists **FEISTLING, Killin’ Void, Ion Diary,** and **funiel**, spanning Drum & Bass, Dubstep, and House.
- **Custom Content:** Includes a fully functional **Beatmap Editor** at launch. Create your own maps with your own music.
- **Social Multiplayer:** Climb side-by-side with friends in real-time.
[media]

### 🚀 EARLY ACCESS ROADMAP

The climb is just beginning. We are committed to delivering frequent updates based on your feedback. Planned features include:

- **More Songs:** Even more original songs coming soon.
- **Voice Chat:** In-game communication.
- **Character Customization:** Personalize your avatar’s look.
- **Cross-Platform Play:** Expanding to other VR headsets.

Join our community to help shape the future of Peak Rhythm!


**[Discord Link: https://discord.gg/RZuzxpRcyV]**
